questions.question: Why does the speaker recommend the Sky Hotel?

analyses.content: 录音中明确说到推荐这家酒店是因为它有“极其舒适的床（incredibly cozy beds）”，这直接对应选项A的comfortable。
录音虽然提到了健康和体育俱乐部（health and sports clubs），但强调这是“大多数酒店都有的”，并非它被强烈推荐的原因，听题时注意不要因为听到选项原词就急于做出选择。

This might be the first time coming here for some of you, so for those who are still wondering about the right accommodation, I recommend Sky Hotel. It has its own health and sports clubs, just like most of the hotels here, but I love it because of its incredibly cozy beds, which guarantees good rest after an exhausting day of exploration.

questions.question: What is new in this year’s exhibition?

analyses.content: 录音中明确指出今年展会“增加了四台能模仿滑雪过程的电脑（added four computers which can imitate the process of skiing）”，这完全对应选项C的电脑模拟。
你可能会听到照片展和滑雪装备，但录音特意用“像往常一样（like always）”说明这些是以前就有的，并非今年的新看点，一定要注意区分新旧信息的限定词。

The exhibition this year provides a colorful look into the history of skiing and an inspiring peek into the future prospects of the sport. Apart from the fascinating photo exhibitions and the most up-to-date skiing gear like always, this year we have added four computers which can imitate the process of skiing, ensuring the same physical activity and sensations that appear during the skiing process on downhill slopes.

questions.question: How do people enter the skiing and snowboarding competition?

analyses.content: 录音中直接给出了进入比赛最有效的方法是“查看展会通讯（checking out the exhibition newsletter）”，这与选项C的意思完全一致。
录音在提到填门票背面（对应选项B）或发邮件（对应选项A）之前，用了一个非常清晰的否定结构“而不是（rather than）”，如果你不仔细听这个结构，就很容易掉进干扰项的陷阱。

Many have posed the question as to how to enter the skiing and snowboarding competition. Well, rather than filling out the back of the entrance ticket or bombarding the committee with emails, the most effective method is by checking out the exhibition newsletter delivered every month for availability.

questions.question: What did the media focus on this year?

analyses.content: 录音中清楚地说道“我们降低了门票费用，这被当地报纸广泛报道（lowered the entrance fee, which has been widely reported）”，对应选项B的费用减少。
录音确实提到了降雪量（选项A的干扰），但这紧跟着的时间词是“去年（Last year）”，在捕捉听力细节时一定不要把去年的焦点和今年的焦点混淆。

As the most beloved local event, the exhibition has also drawn attention from the press. Last year, massive media coverage was on the worrisome amount of snowfalls. In order to avoid the same predicament, several artificial skiing slopes have been built. With more participants this year, we have lowered the entrance fee, which has been widely reported to local newspapers.

questions.question: Why does the speaker recommend the ski program?

analyses.content: 录音中强调“强烈建议（strongly advise）”大家报名的原因是目前有“史无前例的百分之三十的折扣（unprecedented thirty percent discount）”，这完全对应选项C的当前提供特别优惠。
虽然录音提到了友好的教练和适合初学者，但这只是项目本身的特色介绍，真正让演讲者极力推荐的原因落在了后半句的大幅度折扣上，做题时要抓准导致极力推荐的核心因果关系。

A bonus for our participants is the ski program. It offers a wide variety of lessons and sessions with qualified instructors, ensuring that all ages and abilities are catered to, from the first-timers to seasoned amateurs. I strongly advise you to sign up for the program as it is offering an unprecedented thirty percent discount. That's mainly because we are cooperating with the program organizer who promises affordable prices only for the participants of the festival this year.

analyses.content: 录音说明第一位演讲者Simon会告诉你滑雪者面临的“危险（dangers）”以及如何做好关于事故的“风险管理（risk management）”，这正好对应选项F的安全信息。
因为录音中提到Simon是最好的滑雪教练，你可能会不自觉地脑补这讲的是如何成为教练（选项C）或单纯提高技巧（选项E），请不要脱离具体的演讲内容去只抓身份词。

The first presenter, Simon, is one of our best ski instructors. As an experienced instructor, he will inform you about the dangers that face skiers and snowboarders. Accidents happen mostly to those who are careless or ignorant. Good risk management involves considering both the probability and consequences of an accident.
录音提到这个演讲主要是帮助初学者解决问题，并且明确指出会提供指导帮助你“让鞋子更合脚（make your footwear fit better）”，直接对应选项B的让滑雪靴穿得舒适。
这道题前面抛出了选装备、着装等一连串信息，但最终的落脚点和具体举例完全聚焦在解决“鞋子不舒服（uncomfortable）”上，切忌只听到前面的铺垫信息就匆忙判断。

The next speech, titled Solution, is given by Jamie Kurt. A list of problems may occur to novice skiers and snowboarders, so he is going to offer useful information for first-timers on choosing the appropriate gears, the right dress code, and ways of protecting your skin. For instance, some of you may have rented the skiing equipment, but rental footwear is notoriously uncomfortable. Then Jamie will provide instructions to help make your footwear fit better.
录音中提到这部纪录片（对应题目中的Film）描绘了一群雪上爱好者“探索有着令人惊叹美景的新雪坡（exploring new slopes）”，直接对应选项A的探索新目的地。
录音一开始提到了滑雪和单板滑雪的区别，你可能会顺势以为是在讲技能区分，但紧接着的核心画面描述其实是跟随纪录片去看未知的风景，一定要跟上话题场景的推进。

The third speech is about a documentary introducing skiing and snowboarding and the difference between the two sports. It also depicts a group of snow lovers exploring new slopes with breathtaking views. The director, Andy Fisher, will be there addressing the whole shooting experience.
录音中多次强调演讲者Harry会教你“更有技巧地转弯（turn more skillfully）”并“提高你的平行滑雪技术（improve your parallel skiing technique）”，明显对应选项E的提高滑雪技能。
录音中虽然提到了“失控（out of control）”，你可能会错选成安全相关的F项，但这其实是在说明为什么要通过练习改善技术，重点依然是在滑雪技能的提升上。

The fourth talk is about the tricks of skiing presented by Harry Tyson. It is most useful for those who have already tried skiing, yet still need more practice to master the sport. Harry will teach you how to turn more skillfully. A lot of people can keep their skis roughly parallel, but there's no point if you make it hard to work with and slide around out of control. Useful exercises will also be suggested to improve your parallel skiing technique so that you can tackle steeper slopes and enjoy yourself more.
录音中清楚地讲到，这位演讲者成功地“将雪地攀岩应用到滑雪中（apply snow climbing into skiing）”，攀岩对应其他活动，直接契合选项D的将其他活动与滑雪结合。
录音里谈到了“更平稳（more stable）”和调整步幅等细节，如果你只听懂了这些字面意思，很容易误以为是教你提高滑雪技巧（选项E），但演讲真正的核心看点在于跨界融合了攀岩这项活动。

Jason Smith will be the last presenter, mainly addressing towards advanced skiers. He manages to apply snow climbing into skiing. Climbing in soft snow, you are floundering around. Walking becomes harder, so a good trick during climbing is to maintain a wider gait, approximately shoulder width, so that you are more stable while walking. This works for skiing as well.
